scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.lint: biome check scripts harness.config.json && pnpm --filter @workspace/web run lint
scripts.checks: pnpm run harness:check && pnpm run skills:check && pnpm run content:check && pnpm run brand:check && pnpm run catalog:check && pnpm run claims:check && pnpm run gallery:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --if-present run typecheck
